Director of Commercialization & Corporate Partnerships - New Energy Nexus Director of Commercialization & Corporate Partnerships Hybrid California Full time Berkeley, California, United States Overview Application Share this job Description ABOUT NEW ENERGY NEXUS New Energy Nexus (NEX) is a not-for-profit organization that supports clean energy entrepreneurs with funds, services, and networks. Our vision is a 100% clean energy economy where innovation and communities thrive. As part of NEX’s global network, the New Energy Nexus California Chapter (NEX CA) is accelerating California’s clean energy transition by championing entrepreneurs, commercializing technologies, and co-designing strategies that scale innovation, build trust, and grow industries. With 20+ years of experience guiding entrepreneurs through the early stages of technology development into validation and scale-up, the NEX CA team focuses on the full lifecycle of entrepreneur support and technology commercialization. ABOUT THE ROLE & OPPORTUNITY NEX CA is seeking an experienced, market-driven leader to spearhead commercialization pathways across our long-standing portfolio of programs. These programs include CalSEED, which provides grant funding and wraparound services for the earliest-stage entrepreneurs; CalTestBed, which pairs startups with experts within universities and national labs to validate

These programs include CalSEED, which provides grant funding and wraparound services for the earliest-stage entrepreneurs; CalTestBed, which pairs startups with experts within universities and national labs to validate technologies; and PowerForward, which awards large grants to scale up battery manufacturing with partnerships for workforce development and community benefit.

The Director will lead the strategic mapping of clean energy sectors, and most critically, build high-value relationships and secure tangible engagement with “next-level partners” – including utilities, corporate off-takers, manufacturers, developers, and procurement agencies.
This is a pivotal point in the evolution of NEX CA programs as regulatory, market, and funding landscapes shift rapidly in the clean energy space.
This role will help prepare clean energy entrepreneurs for the path ahead by connecting them with the customers and partners that will allow them to commercialize at scale.

However, successful candidates should bring a strong combination of relevant experience across several of these areas, demonstrating comparable depth and breadth in climate tech commercialization, corporate innovation, and/or market development.

This is a hybrid position based in the San Francisco Bay Area, with an expectation to work out of our Berkeley office a minimum of two designated days per week (Tuesdays and Thursdays), with additional in-person requirements as needed to fulfill the responsibilities above (such as in-person meetings with next-level partners and traveling to external events).

Our vision is a 100% clean energy economy where innovation and communities thrive. As part of NEX’s global network, the New Energy Nexus California Chapter (NEX CA) is accelerating California’s clean energy transition by championing entrepreneurs, commercializing technologies, and co-designing strategies that scale innovation, build trust, and grow industries. With 20+ years of experience guiding entrepreneurs through the early stages of technology development into validation and scale-up, the NEX CA team focuses on the full lifecycle of entrepreneur support and technology commercialization. ABOUT THE ROLE & OPPORTUNITY NEX CA is seeking an experienced marketing leader and storyteller to help create new channels for startups across our long-standing portfolio of programs. These programs include CalSEED, which provides grant funding and wraparound services for the earliest-stage entrepreneurs; CalTestBed, which pairs startups with experts within universities and national labs to validate technologies; and PowerForward, which awards large grants to scale up battery manufacturing with partnerships for workforce development and community benefit.

Global Director of Impact & Knowledge Management - New Energy Nexus Global Director of Impact & Knowledge Management Remote Full time United States Pakistan United Kingdom India Singapore Bangkok, Bangkok, Thailand Overview Application Share this job Description ABOUT NEW ENERGY NEXUS New Energy Nexus (NEX) is an international NGO that supports climate solutions and builds a more equitable clean energy economy. Our laser focus is on clean energy entrepreneurs: providing them with funds, accelerators, and networks to thrive. They are our main audience and our agent of change. We started in California in 2004 and now operate across China, India, Southeast Asia, East and West Africa, and Australia. We have leveraged US$5.4 billion in investment and supported more than 11,000 entrepreneurs. ABOUT THE ROLE & OPPORTUNITY The Global Impact Director & Knowledge Management is the champion of New Energy Nexus’ ambition to be a true learning organization. They will lead the Monitoring, Evaluation, and Learning function at New Energy Nexus (NEX) that tracks, highlights, and strengthens the impact of the NEX network. The role owns NEX Global Monitoring, Evaluation, and Learning (MEL) framework, collaborates with the leadership to refine and maintain global Theory of Change (TOC), is the organization’s leading subject matter expert on disciplined TOC development and evaluations and supports
It supports the network to keep a common strategic direction and demonstrate its collective impact to funders, partners, and the wider clean energy entrepreneurship ecosystem.

Lead the organization-wide knowledge management structure, data systems, and AI strategy for the purposes of MEL, program design, and stakeholder management, ensuring information on program participants, partners, funders, investors etc can be connected and used across teams.
Oversee the governance, security, and responsible use of organizational data, including in AI-enabled knowledge tools.
Leverage AI and integrate it into NEX's MEL systems to build efficiency and standardization in data collection, validation, analysis, and reporting, while protecting data privacy and quality.
At least 3 years experience in working in organizations focused on climate change, clean energy and/or entrepreneurship.

Proven ability to influence culture and collective behavior of a mission driven team to create enthusiasm for, collective ownership of and appreciation for a MEL as a core strategic competency Foundational knowledge of the climate, clean energy, and entrepreneurship support landscape, and willingness to engage in in-depth self-learning on any gaps.

Demonstrated ability to stay ahead of emerging trends, technologies, and best practices in MEL and knowledge management, including the use of AI and digital tools to improve data analysis, organizational learning, and impact measurement.
Experience leveraging AI and/or automation tools to build processes and systems for knowledge and data management.

Experience working with accelerators, incubators, or other entrepreneurship support programs, and tracking post-program outcomes for startups and small businesses Benefits BENEFITS AND COMPENSATION This is a full-time remote position.
Applicable benefits such as medical, dental, vision, paid time off, paid holidays and insurance will depend on the location of the selected candidate.

Energy Efficiency & Conservation (EEC) Program - New Energy Nexus Search for: Discover programs & events in your region Discover programs & events in your region New Energy Nexus programs China Indonesia Japan Philippines Thailand Uganda USA - California USA - New York Vietnam NEX Ventures Programs we run with our partners Australia - Energy Lab Australia - AusTestBed Nigeria - Clean Technology Hub Pakistan - Renewables First Back to global website About Our story Our people Chapters & partners Australia California China India Indonesia New York Nigeria Pakistan Philippines Thailand UAE Uganda Vietnam Careers Contact us Impact Portfolio News For Entrepreneurs Donate PROGRAM (Program concluded) Energy Efficiency & Conservation (EEC) Program About A program under the grant project establishing an Energy Efficiency Incubation Hub in Northern Mindanao , under USAID Energy Secure Philippines The Energy Efficiency and Conservation Law (RA 11285) marks a significant milestone in the Department of Energy’s commitment to sustainable energy use in the Philippines. Although still in its early stages, RA 11285 is a groundbreaking effort in the country’s energy landscape. To support this initiative, the “Establishing an Energy Efficiency Incubation Hub in Northern Mindanao” project aims to build the entrepreneurial capacity of individuals and companies in Region X. This project includes

This project includes the Energy Efficiency and Conservation (EEC) Program, a 16-week hybrid business incubation program designed to help renewable energy startups and companies in Northern Mindanao launch and operate Energy Service Companies (ESCOs).

Program Objectives Growth Opportunities Identify and nurture high-potential EEC innovations in the region of Northern Mindanao In-depth market insights Foster collaboration and knowledge sharing within the EEC ecosystem in the region Empower EEC startups Support early-stage EEC startups; Aid in the promotion of EEC in Northern Mindanao.
Who can apply ​​Early-stage startups, individuals, teams, or enterprises offering solutions within the domain of innovations and technologies in energy efficiency and conservation.

Small-scale renewable energy companies who are seeking to diversify their service portfolio to include offerings such as energy auditing services and other products and services related to energy efficiency and conservation.
Intended outcomes The program aims to increase the number of ESCOs in the region, which aligns with the DOE’s goals and initiatives in promoting energy efficiency and conservation.
Through the 16-week incubation program, the individuals and RE companies participating will be equipped with the necessary skills in piloting and launching EEC products and services.
Early-stage companies are encouraged to apply.
